description: Retrieve the staged-plan branch of expandForAnalyzer. The 2-arg overload (List<String>, StagedPlanIndex) resolves analyzer-requested chunks that the agent has staged in the current plan but Neo4j has not re-indexed yet — keystone of multi-iteration safeloop convergence. Currently exercised by zero golden fixtures.
query: How does SafeLoopTools resolve analyzer-requested chunk ids that were created by the current plan but are not yet present in the Neo4j graph?
